gallery.title: File:Coronation Tree Planting Toronto, Canada (52876248800).jpg
gallery.description: Ceremonial shovels placed next to a plaque to mark the oak tree planted at a ceremonial tree planting earlier that day at Coronation Park. The ceremonial tree planting was part of the City of Toronto's local commemorations for King Charles III's coronation, which also included the raising of the Canadian coronation flag and an offering of tobacco from the Mississaugas First Nations at Coronation Park.

gallery.title: File:Crown of Scotland 2023.jpg
gallery.description:
Tweet Text: 
His Majesty King Charles III was presented with the Honours of Scotland today at St Giles’ Cathedral. 
This followed a People’s Procession and Royal Procession on the Royal Mile. 

A 21-Gun Salute and flypast by the Red Arrows also took place.
